online.title: Online
online.lead: Live small-group classes with individual attention from your teacher.
online.body: Train at home or while travelling without compromising on quality. Your teacher sees you in real time, explains the details and corrects your technique. All you need is a little space and a stable internet connection.

programs.name: Classical + Stretching
programs.description: Posture, elegant lines and safe flexibility work combined in one balanced program.

programs.name: Ballroom + Stretching
programs.description: Rhythm, coordination and fluid movement, with no partner required.

programs.name: The Full Experience
programs.description: A complete program for developing technique, musicality, strength and flexibility.

programs.name: Private Online Class
programs.description: The content and pace are fully adapted to your goals and experience.

studio.title: Studio
studio.lead: In-person classes with precise feedback and the atmosphere of a dance studio.
studio.body: Studio training lets your teacher work more closely with alignment, movement quality and technical detail. It is ideal for deeper practice, preparing an individual routine or anyone who prefers face-to-face guidance.

programs.name: Classical Dance
programs.description: Technique, posture, coordination and expression with precise personal corrections.

programs.name: Ballroom Dance
programs.description: Develop steps, rhythm, fluidity and confidence. No partner is required.

programs.name: Stretching
programs.description: Safely improve flexibility, mobility and body control with your individual needs in mind.

programs.name: Personal Program
programs.description: Goals, schedule and lesson content are designed specifically for you.
